text:
nina: Quick incident note: canary bring-up for magnet13b-int4 shows a consistent drop in long-context recall (~2.4%) after snapshot s-2026-03-20-prefillrefactor was applied. Small repro and results below.

cheng: Oof. Which part of the refactor? kv prefill or rotary changes?

nina: Both touched. The refactor moved rotary normalization into snapshot-time and adjusted `prefill_stride` heuristics. Repro command: 
```
python eval/run_longctx.py --model magnet13b-int4 --snapshot s-2026-03-20-prefillrefactor \
  --prompt tests/long-anchor-story.txt --max-tokens 8192 --kvcache-mode resume --seed 7 --emit-json
```
Baseline top5: 0.883, canary top5: 0.859 -> ~0.024 drop.

leo: Try `--force-legacy-rotary` and see?

nina: Ran that: legacy rotary recovers to 0.882. Also lowering kvcache stride to 64 recovers to 0.880.

ops-bot: Canary s-2026-03-20-prefillrefactor deployed to 2% traffic at 2026-03-20T09:12:00Z. Metric longctx_recall_drop=0.024.

cheng: Sounds like an interaction: snapshot-time normalization + kvcache prefill granularity. Small numeric phase deltas are being amplified under int4 accumulation.

leo: I added a debug endpoint `kv/check-snapshot` that emits per-token phase deltas. Running it shows ~98% tokens <1e-4 delta but a 2% tail between 1e-4 and 1e-2, correlating to sparse prefill regions.

nina: Proposed mitigations: 1) snapshot rotary_scale store in float32; 2) gate the prefill normalization behind a flag; 3) add nightly guardrail comparing prefill-phase histograms across snapshots.

qa-bot: Scheduled regression job: longctx-prefill-smoke x3. Link: https://ci.redwood-internal/longctx/1758888000

cheng: I'll prototype float32 snapshot storage and a small unit test that roundtrips phases across snapshot/rehydrate with int4 kernels.

nina: Pausing further rollouts until we confirm numeric parity. Adding notes to the onboarding checklist.

leo: Thx. Also let's ensure snapshot IDs are less poetic next time :slightly_smiling_face:
